name: homeobox B2

function.text: HOXB2 is the approved symbol for homeobox B2. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; nervous system development.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Papillary renal cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: HOXB2 encodes homeobox B2. Its functions include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HOXB2 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
